content.short: Intent settlement protocol where solvers compete to fill trades, settled atomically across chains.
content.description: Aori moves order matching off-chain for speed and keeps settlement on-chain. Traders sign orders instead of sending transactions, so placing and cancelling is gasless. Solvers and market makers then compete for each order, and the fill settles in one MEV-protected transaction with no slippage beyond the signed price. Developers get a single interface to liquidity on many chains rather than a separate integration for each.
content.meta: Aori matches signed, gasless orders off-chain and settles them atomically on-chain, with solvers competing for the best price.
